archive_safety: Only regular .py/.json/.patch members. No model/native binaries or raw dependency source trees.
member_bytes: All selected original members are byte-identical; derived upstream metadata is separately identified.
note: CPU proof counts and limits are taken from the original retained reports, not from packaging assertions.
